newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle steady $67.00, light - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle steady $67.00, light - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said.
Limited test slaughter steers steady, heifers not tested.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 800 slaughter steers and no heifers following the weekly movement of 91,200 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 67.00.
Confirmed - 800 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 400
